modeNotes.chimps: CHIMPS strips income and selling: farms, Merchantmen, Benjamin’s cash and Bloon Trap give nothing. Value comes from efficient DPS per dollar, camo/lead/fortified coverage, and buffs (Alch, Village, Overclock).
modeNotes.boss: Boss events reward economy (BRF/Marketplace/Merchantmen + Benjamin) and raw single-target damage amplified by debuffs (Super Brittle, Embrittlement) and buffs. Bosses ignore stuns/slows/knockback.

dangerRounds.title: First MOAB
dangerRounds.threat: A single MOAB with no prior MOAB pressure — the first real DPS check.

dangerRounds.title: Dense Leads & Ceramics
dangerRounds.threat: Massive ceramic rush with lead bloons mixed in — a pierce and lead-popping check.

dangerRounds.title: Regrow Ceramic Rush
dangerRounds.threat: Dense regrow ceramics that refill layers if not finished quickly.
counters: Druid Heart of Oak (x-2-x) blocks regrow

dangerRounds.title: Camo Ceramic Waves
dangerRounds.threat: Fast camo ceramics — any DPS without camo detection is wasted.
counters: Ice Embrittlement or Mortar Signal Flare strips camo

dangerRounds.title: DDT Rush
dangerRounds.threat: Many DDTs — fast, camo, lead & black properties (immune to sharp and explosive without help).
counters: Embrittlement / Shattering Shells to strip properties

dangerRounds.title: Mass Fortified BFB / ZOMG
dangerRounds.threat: The classic run-ender: a dense wall of fortified MOAB-class.
counters: Ninja 0-4-0 Bloon Sabotage + Sniper Maim MOAB stuns
First Strike / MOAB Assassin abilities saved for this round
Call to Arms + Overclock timed on your carry

dangerRounds.title: Fortified DDTs
dangerRounds.threat: Fortified DDTs that punish weak damage-per-hit and lack of camo/black coverage.
counters: Re-check every carry has camo + MIB

dangerRounds.title: B.A.D.
dangerRounds.threat: Big Airship of Doom: immune to stuns, slows and knockback; spawns ZOMGs & DDTs on death.
counters: Pure single-target DPS: Sun Temple, Legend of the Night, MOAB Eliminator, Ray of Doom
Ice Embrittlement / Super Brittle damage amp
Save MOAB-killer abilities for the children
Don’t rely on Maim/Sabotage/Glue — BAD ignores them

heroSynergies.name: Geraldo
synergies: Sharpening Stone on your main carry (Crossbow Master, Sniper)
Creepy Idol / Jar of Pickles stall & black-bloon help
Fertilizer accelerates Banana Farms in boss events
Paragon Power Totem for degree boosting
heroSynergies.tip: Level him early — the shop unlocks scale with level and items are cheap for their value.

heroSynergies.name: Sauda
synergies: Carries R1–R60 nearly solo → save cash for T4/T5 MOAB answers
Pair with MOAB-class specialists: Sniper 4-0-2, Bomb 2-4-0, Ninja Sabotage
Place at a track crossing for maximum sword uptime
Weak late game — plan your R80+ DPS early
heroSynergies.tip: Her value is the cash she saves you; spend it on the MOAB carry before R63.

heroSynergies.name: Benjamin
synergies: Passive cash each round + Bank Hack boosts Monkey Banks
Biohack ability buffs adjacent towers for big burst windows
Stacks with BRF/Marketplace/Merchant setups
Useless income in CHIMPS (income disabled)
heroSynergies.tip: Place him first in boss events; his early cash compounds into the R40 checkpoint.

heroSynergies.name: Psi
synergies: Alch + Village buffs boost his blast rate
Psionic Scream for MOAB-class waves (R98)
Cover his weak pierce with Necromancer / Crossbow Master
Check boss immunities before relying on him
heroSynergies.tip: Excellent filler single-target; treat abilities like a mini MOAB Assassin.

heroSynergies.name: Admiral Brickell
synergies: Naval Tactics boosts attack speed of water towers (Sub Commander, Pirates, Mermonkey)
Mega Mine deletes MOAB-class on R98/R100
Pair with Sub 2-0-5 for decamo + lead
Merchantman eco synergy in boss events
heroSynergies.tip: Only pick her on maps with real water space near the track.

bosses.name: Bloonarius
bosses.note: Spawns bloons as it takes damage. Needs strong cleanup + single-target carry; Spike Factory end-of-track helps.

bosses.name: Lych
bosses.note: Steals buffs and drains lives via its soul; Ezili Heartstopper and life generation (Healthy Bananas) help.

bosses.name: Vortex
bosses.note: Very fast; stuns towers. Needs damage concentrated near spawn and range coverage.

bosses.name: Dreadbloon
bosses.note: Armored with lead/fortified shields — bring MIB/lead-popping burst for shield phases.

bosses.name: Phayze
bosses.note: Blinds and disables towers in phases — spread DPS and keep camo detection redundant.

bosses.name: Blastapopoulos
bosses.note: Overheats and stuns towers; heat-resistant positioning and alternating carries matter.
